title: Shared cart state and guarded routes
summary: Keep cart items in a shared ref, derive the total with computed, and guard checkout routes.

scenario.briefing: The cart total drifts from the item list because a watcher copies it into a second ref. Checkout also opens with an empty cart. Derive the total and guard the route.

objectives.description: Apply the taught syntax in a working file.
Review an artifact and identify the concrete risks.

hints: Keep items in a module-scope ref so every caller sees the same cart.
Replace the total ref and watcher with computed(function sum() { ... }).
Update existing quantities through the shared ref so Vue can track the change.
Register the guard with router.beforeEach and return a catalog route for an empty cart.

misconceptions.description: Synchronizing derived state with a watcher.
misconceptions.feedback: Derived values should be computed from their source. A watcher creates a second source of truth that can drift.
misconceptions.testDescription: The total is derived with computed instead of a watcher.

misconceptions.description: Writing to a prop in a child component.
misconceptions.feedback: Props are read-only. Emit an event and let the owner update the state.
misconceptions.diagnostic: Writing to props.quantity warns and the parent never receives the new value.

misconceptions.description: Shipping a watcher that mirrors derived state.
misconceptions.feedback: The watcher creates a second source of truth that can drift. Block the change and derive the total with computed.

sections.title: Derived state has one source
sections.body: A total is a function of the items. computed caches that function and invalidates it when a dependency changes, so there is no second ref to keep in sync.

sections.title: Shared state lives above components
sections.body: A ref declared at module scope is shared by every caller of the composable. Components subscribe to the same source instead of copying it.

sections.title: Guards decide before navigation
sections.body: A router.beforeEach guard runs before the destination renders. Returning a route location redirects, and returning true allows navigation.

steps.title: Derive cart state and guard checkout
steps.prompt: Edit useCart.ts. Replace the watcher with computed state, share the cart through module scope, and redirect an empty cart away from checkout.

tests.description: The total is derived with computed instead of a watcher.
The shared cart state drives a navigation guard.

hints: Import computed and drop watch from the imports.
Keep items at module scope and replace total with computed.
Sum item.price * item.quantity inside the computed callback.
Call router.beforeEach, check to.meta.requiresCart, and return the catalog route when items is empty.

artifact.title: CartLine.vue
artifact.caption: The component mutates a prop and keeps a derived total in a watcher.

findings.label: The increase handler assigns directly to a prop.
The watcher copies a derived total into its own ref instead of using computed.
The artifact derives the total with computed instead of a watcher.

verdicts.label: Block the change; the prop mutation and duplicated derived state must be fixed.
Ship it; the watcher keeps the total in sync.
Only the template formatting needs work.

steps.explanation: The child writes to props.quantity, which Vue treats as read-only and the parent never sees. The watcher also mirrors price times quantity into a second ref, creating two sources of truth that can drift.
hints: Check every assignment that targets props.
Decide whether total is derived or stored twice.
Ignore findings that describe behavior the artifact does not have.
Block the change when both a prop write and duplicated derived state are present.
